**Prerequisites:** [M16 Classical Machine Learning](m16.qmd), [M26 LLM Foundations](m26.qmd) · **GPU:** optional

| # | Lesson | Level | Status | What you learn |
| :-: | :--- | :--- | :-: | :--- |
| 01 | Interpretable Glassbox Models (InterpretML) | 🟢 Beginner | 🛠️ in progress | Inherently interpretable model families and their transparency tradeoffs. |
| 02 | Game Theory XAI (SHAP) | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Shapley-value-based feature attribution grounded in cooperative game theory. |
| 03 | Model Interpretability | 🔴 Expert | 🛠️ in progress | Feature importance, SHAP, LIME, and explainability. |
| 04 | Local Surrogate Perturbation (LIME) | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Explaining individual predictions via local surrogate models. |
| 05 | Deep Learning Attribution (Captum) | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Gradient- and attribution-based explainability for neural networks. |
| 06 | Mechanistic Interpretability (Sparse Autoencoders) |  | 🛠️ in progress |  |
| 07 | Counterfactual Reasoning (Alibi Explain) | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Generating counterfactual examples to explain decision boundaries. |
| 08 | Statistical Fairness Auditing (Fairlearn) | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Measuring and auditing fairness metrics across protected groups. |
| 09 | Algorithmic Bias Mitigation (AIF360) | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Bias mitigation techniques applied pre-, in-, and post-processing. |
| 10 | Differential Privacy in DL (Opacus) | 🔴 Expert | 🛠️ in progress | Training neural networks with differential privacy guarantees. |
| 11 | Real-Time PII Sanitization (Presidio) | 🔴 Expert | 🛠️ in progress | Detecting and anonymizing personally identifiable information in text. |
| 12 | LLM Guardrails & Jailbreak Defense (NeMo) | 🔴 Expert | 🛠️ in progress | Guardrail policies and jailbreak-resistant LLM application design. |
| 13 | Safety Classifiers (Llama Guard) |  | 🛠️ in progress |  |
| 14 | LLM Red Teaming (garak & PyRIT) |  | 🛠️ in progress |  |
| 15 | Watermarking & Content Provenance (SynthID, C2PA) |  | 🛠️ in progress |  |
| 16 | Automated Model Governance (Model Cards) | 🔴 Expert | 🛠️ in progress | Automated documentation, compliance tracking, and model card generation for governance. |
| 17 | EU AI Act & AI Governance Frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) |  | 🛠️ in progress |  |
